newsitem.title: GERMANY: Telekom bucks trend, hits all-time high.
newsitem.headline: Telekom bucks trend, hits all-time high.

text.p: Shares in German telecoms giant Deutsche Telekom AG hit an all-time high on Friday morning as investors continued to buy into a shortage of the stock, dealers said.
Telekom, leading volumes among the 30 blue chip shares, hit a new high of 37.50 marks before easing back to trade at 37.17 marks at 0820 GMT, up 25 pfennigs.
The IBIS DAX index, which tracks electronic trade in the DAX-30, was down one percent at 3,332.93 points, tracking a sharp fall on the Dow Jones index.

Dealers said demand for Telekom had soared in recent days as fund managers sought to capitalise on the share's relatively cheap price in light of an otherwise general surge on the German share market.
That had led to a shortage of supply in the stock, which was pushing the price up still further.
